lines: Why pay hundreds for a brand name, when a cheaper alternative might do the same job?
Sometimes, you're paying more for the logo, the marketing, and the prestige. Not necessarily better performance.
Affordable alternatives can offer impressive quality and functionality, without the premium price tag.
Of course, counterfeits aren't always better.
Genuine products can offer safer materials, warranties, and better quality control.
Think about what you're actually paying for.
